title: 第11章 绝不坐着等死第12章 刺探
slug: 共梦后被顶级凶兽们亲哭了
lines: 半兽人都有一个共性，脾气很拧，杀气重。
还有极强的报复心。
苏芽芽不敢得罪这个炸弹，继续好言相劝：“我是被派来负责照顾你，我尽量把工作做好，让你住得舒服一点，你也配合一下我？”
她不指望几句话能消除他的戾气，但是她也没别的招了。
“你的水是定量定时的，要是超过时间段，我就不能给你倒水了。”苏芽芽看了一眼时间，再啰嗦一句，“还有五分钟。”
半虎兽人咬紧后槽牙，好像是准备把苏芽芽的脖子给咬断。
“还有四分钟。”苏芽芽无奈地叹口气，他不配合，她也没招。
反观半虎兽人直接闭上眼，不再理她。
苏芽芽放弃劝说，反正那一杯他喝下去了，她就不用着急了。
趁着半兽人闭上眼，她把棍子探进去些。
“啪！”磁铁隔空将杯子吸住，发出响动。
苏芽芽火速撤棍。
好在半虎兽人连眼皮都不抬。
她把棍子放下，去收拾另一个角落。
这一忙活就到了晚上十点，下班点到了。
夜里巡逻的人负责接手这些半兽人，次日九点再交班。
苏芽芽看到对面的大姐开始收拾，旁边的看守员也有几个沿着通道离开的，她才敢收拾东西。
在这里打工，当第一个下班的人需要勇气。
这时，她余光看到缠着白绷带的205一瘸一拐地出现。
都伤成这样了，他来这里做什么？
苏芽芽本能地警惕起来。
要么是报复她，害他来顶班受伤。
要么是——
报复半虎兽人！？
205揣在怀里的手往外一掏，露出眼熟的泛着寒光的黑色金属边缘。
苏芽芽顿时把手里的东西都砸了过去。
“咣当！”饭盒子在地上砸出巨大的动静，顿时吸引了旁边人的注意。
“干什么呢？！”巡逻的人大喊着。
“妈的，解决完这个王八犊子，”205被苏芽芽一堆东西砸到受伤的手臂，倒抽一口气，发着狠，“老子再来收拾你！”
“也得看你有没有命！”苏芽芽抄起棍子就砸！
根本不给205再次出手的机会。
她也不是白在末世待了一年多。
抢食物。
抢物资。
不抢，自己就得死！
半兽人要是在她手里出了事，那她也会被连带挨顿鞭打！
她连个朋友也没有，受了重伤，斗兽场可不会管她死活，而那些所谓同事只会把她所有的东西搜刮光。
content_en:
Orcs all have one thing in common: they have a bad temper and murderous intent.
He also has a strong desire for revenge.
Su Yaya did not dare to offend this bomb, and continued to persuade her nicely: "I was sent to take care of you. I will try my best to do my job well and make your life more comfortable. Will you cooperate with me?"
She didn't expect a few words to eliminate his anger, but she had no other options.
"Your water is rationed and timed. If it exceeds the time limit, I won't be able to pour you water." Su Yaya glanced at the time and said, "There are still five minutes left."
The half-tiger orc clenched his back molars, as if preparing to bite Su Yaya's neck off.
"There are still four minutes." Su Yaya sighed helplessly. If he didn't cooperate, she wouldn't do anything.
On the other hand, the half-tiger orc simply closed his eyes and ignored her.
Su Yaya gave up the persuasion. He drank the cup anyway, so she didn't have to worry.
While the orc closed his eyes, she inserted the stick deeper.
"Crack!" The magnet sucked the cup into the air and made a sound.
Su Yaya quickly withdrew the stick.
Fortunately, the half-tiger orc didn't even raise an eyelid.
She put the stick down and went to tidy up another corner.
This busy work lasted until ten o'clock in the evening, and it was time to get off work.
Those who patrol at night are responsible for taking over these orcs, and will take over at nine o'clock the next day.
Su Yaya saw the eldest sister opposite starting to pack up, and a few guards nearby were also leaving along the passage, so she dared to pack up her things.
To work here, it takes courage to be the first person to get off work.
At this time, she saw 205 limping out of the corner of her eye, wrapped in white bandages.
He was injured like this, what was he doing here?
Su Yaya instinctively became vigilant.
Either to take revenge on her and cause him to take over the job and get hurt.
Either—
Revenge against the half-tiger orcs! ?
205 took out the hand in his arms, revealing a familiar black metal edge with a cold light.
Su Yaya immediately smashed everything in her hand.
"Bang!" The lunch box hit the ground with a loud noise, immediately attracting the attention of people nearby.
"What are you doing?!" the patrolman yelled.
"Damn it, after we finish dealing with this bastard," 205 gasped as Su Yaya hit his injured arm with a bunch of things, "I'll deal with you again!"
"It depends on whether you are alive or not!" Su Yaya picked up the stick and smashed it!
Don't give 205 a chance to take action again.
She didn't stay in the apocalypse for more than a year in vain.
Grab food.
Grab supplies.
If you don't grab it, you will die!
If something happens to an orc in her hands, she will also be whipped!
She didn't even have a friend, she was seriously injured, the Colosseum wouldn't care about her life or death, and those so-called colleagues would just plunder all her belongings.
title_en: Chapter 11 Never sit and wait for death Chapter 12 Spy
